statements.note: Public API additions are all optional (new optional engine options, new methods, SingleSessionHTTPServer constructor now takes options), and no public name was removed. But isValidSessionId changed from 'any non-empty string' (base) to a whitelist /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/ with max length 100, so session IDs with other characters or >100 chars that were previously accepted now get rejected, and the 400 error response path was restructured. Whether that breaks any real client is not settleable by a concrete check (server issues UUID session IDs), so neither TRUE nor FALSE is supported.
